environment: Apple M2, macOS, local (no cloud), go test -bench / go test, single machine

xds_propagation_latency.tool: test/benchmark/xds_scale_test.go (real gRPC ADS clients against a real running control plane, real network sockets on localhost)
xds_propagation_latency.note: Reconcile interval in this test was 200ms; measured latency is dominated by that periodic tick, not by client fan-out cost -- flat across client counts confirms fan-out itself is cheap at this scale.

endpoint_churn.tool: test/benchmark/churn_test.go (real registry + real reconciler, 100 services / 1000 endpoints pre-populated, then 2s of continuous register+heartbeat+deregister churn)

not_yet_measured: 100 real Envoy proxy instances (this run used real gRPC ADS clients simulating Envoy's xDS behavior, not full Envoy binaries, due to local machine resource constraints)
control-plane CPU utilization under sustained load (requires longer-duration profiling run with pprof CPU profile, deferred)
